title: microgramma bifrons
intro: Microgramma bifrons, commonly known as the Silver Fern or Silver Leaved Fern, is a species of fern native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote health and well-being, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Microgramma bifrons include reducing stress and anxiety, as well as improving sleep quality, due to its calming and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
